summary: The EDA controller is a single-node system running long-lived processes like rulebook activations, scaled by CPU cores. Minimum: 16 GB RAM, 4 CPUs, 40 GB disk with 20 GB under `/var` (double it for many large projects or decision environments) and 3000 IOPS; each activation uses about 250 MB, so test heavy rulebooks in staging.
